panels.description:
Corosync links (link0, link1...) that reach every other cluster node, from "corosync-cfgtool -s".
✔ green "UP 2/2" = all links healthy
▲ orange "DEGRADED 1/2" = a link lost at least one node (cluster still runs on the other link)
⛔ red "DOWN" = no link reaches the other nodes. See "Corosync Link Timeline".

panels.description:
One row per physical NIC (1G, 10G, 25G...). [xxG] = max speed of the card.
✔ green "UP 10G" = link up at the card's own max speed, no errors
▲ orange "UP 10G (below max)" = link up but slower than the card supports (check cable/SFP/switch port)
⚠ yellow "· 1–99 Errors" = new RX/TX errors in that interval
▲ orange "· 100–999 Errors"
⛔ red "· 1K+ Errors" or "DOWN" = link down / severe errors
Errors counted: CRC, Length, Missed, Overrun, FIFO, Frame, Carrier, Aborted, Heartbeat, Window, Collisions.

targets.query:
import "join"

phys = from(bucket: "${Bucket}")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_measurement"] == "nics" and r["host"] == "${server}")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_field"] == "link_speed_max")
  |> keep(columns: ["instance"])
  |> group()
  |> distinct(column: "instance")
  |> findColumn(fn: (key) => true, column: "_value")

link = from(bucket: "${Bucket}")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_measurement"] == "nics" and r["host"] == "${server}")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_field"] == "network_up" or r["_field"] == "link_speed" or r["_field"] == "link_speed_max")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => contains(value: r.instance, set: phys))
  |> group(columns: ["instance", "_field"], mode: "by")
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: last, createEmpty: false)
  |> group(columns: ["instance"], mode: "by")
  |> pivot(rowKey: ["_time"], columnKey: ["_field"], valueColumn: "_value")
  |> sort(columns: ["_time"])
  |> fill(column: "link_speed_max", usePrevious: true)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => exists r.link_speed_max and r.link_speed_max > 0.0)
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({ _time: r._time, instance: r.instance, mx: r.link_speed_max,
      lv: if exists r.network_up and r.network_up == 1.0
          then (if exists r.link_speed and r.link_speed > 0.0 then r.link_speed else 1.0) else 0.0 }))
  |> group()

err = from(bucket: "${Bucket}")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_measurement"] == "nics" and r["host"] == "${server}")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_field"] =~ /^(rx_crc_errors|rx_length_errors|rx_missed_errors|rx_over_errors|rx_fifo_errors|rx_frame_errors|tx_carrier_errors|tx_aborted_errors|tx_fifo_errors|tx_heartbeat_errors|tx_window_errors|collisions)$/)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => contains(value: r.instance, set: phys))
  |> group(columns: ["instance", "_field"], mode: "by")
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: last, createEmpty: false)
  |> difference(nonNegative: true)
  |> group(columns: ["instance"], mode: "by")
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: sum, createEmpty: false)
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({ _time: r._time, instance: r.instance, ev: r._value }))
  |> group()

join.left(left: link, right: err,
    on: (l, r) => l._time == r._time and l.instance == r.instance,
    as: (l, r) => {
        e = if exists r.ev then r.ev else 0.0
        b = if e >= 1000.0 then 0.3 else if e >= 100.0 then 0.2 else if e >= 1.0 then 0.1 else 0.0
        return { _time: l._time, nic: l.instance + " [" + string(v: l.mx / 1000.0) + "G]",
                 // below the card max speed (e.g. 25G card at 10G) -> negative, shown orange
                 _value: if l.lv == 0.0 then 0.0
                         else if l.lv > 1.0 and l.lv < l.mx then -(l.lv + b) else l.lv + b }
    })
  |> group(columns: ["nic"], mode: "by")
  |> sort(columns: ["_time"])
  |> yield(name: "status")

panels.title: NIC Link Status

panels.description:
State of each corosync link over time and the interface it runs on, e.g. "link0 (vmbr0)", "link1 (nic2)". Value = nodes reachable on that link. "(no local IP)" = this node has no interface with the link address (link not configured on this node / interface down or without IP).
✔ green "UP 2/2 nodes" = reaches every node
▲ orange DEGRADED = some nodes unreachable
⛔ red DOWN = no node reachable

targets.query:
import "strings"

from(bucket: "${Bucket}")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_measurement"] == "system" and r["host"] == "${server}")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_field"] =~ /^corosync_link[0-9]+_(connected|peers|iface)$/)
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: last, createEmpty: false)
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({ _time: r._time, _value: string(v: r._value),
      link: strings.split(v: r._field, t: "_")[1], metric: strings.split(v: r._field, t: "_")[2] }))
  |> group(columns: ["link"])
  |> pivot(rowKey: ["_time"], columnKey: ["metric"], valueColumn: "_value")
  |> map(fn: (r) => {
      c = if exists r.connected then int(v: r.connected) else 0
      n = if exists r.peers then int(v: r.peers) else 0
      iface = if exists r.iface then r.iface else "no local IP"
      state = if n > 0 and c == n then "✔ UP" else if c > 0 then "▲ DEGRADED" else "⛔ DOWN"
      return { _time: r._time, link: r.link + " (" + iface + ")",
               _value: state + " " + string(v: c) + "/" + string(v: n) + " nodes" }
  })
  |> group(columns: ["link"])

panels.title: NIC TX Errors (Since Boot)

panels.description:
Number of NEW RX errors in each time interval (delta of the ip -s link counters). A bar = errors occurred at that time. Yellow dashed line = 1 error (attention), red dashed line = 100 errors (critical). The legend table is sorted by Total (descending), so the NIC / error type with the most errors is always on top.
• CRC: corrupted frames — bad cable / SFP / optics
• Length: frames with an invalid length
• Missed / Overrun / RX FIFO: NIC or ring buffer overflow — CPU/IRQ cannot keep up
• Frame: frame alignment errors
• RX Errors (total): sum of all RX error types

targets.query:
phys = from(bucket: "${Bucket}")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_measurement"] == "nics" and r["host"] == "${server}")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_field"] == "link_speed_max")
  |> keep(columns: ["instance"])
  |> group()

  |> filter(fn: (r) => contains(value: r.instance, set: phys))
  |> group(columns: ["instance", "_field"], mode: "by")
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: last, createEmpty: false)
  |> difference(nonNegative: true)
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({ r with series: r.instance + "  ·  " + (if r._field == "rx_errors" then "RX Errors (total)" else if r._field == "rx_crc_errors" then "CRC" else if r._field == "rx_length_errors" then "Length" else if r._field == "rx_missed_errors" then "Missed" else if r._field == "rx_over_errors" then "Overrun" else if r._field == "rx_fifo_errors" then "RX FIFO" else if r._field == "rx_frame_errors" then "Frame" else if r._field == "rx_dropped" then "RX Dropped" else if r._field == "rx_nohandler" then "RX No Handler" else if r._field == "tx_errors" then "TX Errors (total)" else if r._field == "tx_dropped" then "TX Dropped" else if r._field == "tx_carrier_errors" then "Carrier" else if r._field == "tx_aborted_errors" then "Aborted" else if r._field == "tx_fifo_errors" then "TX FIFO" else if r._field == "tx_heartbeat_errors" then "Heartbeat" else if r._field == "tx_window_errors" then "Window" else if r._field == "collisions" then "Collisions" else r._field) }))
  |> group(columns: ["series"], mode: "by")
  |> keep(columns: ["_time", "_value", "series"])

• Aborted / Window / Heartbeat: physical-layer errors

• RX No Handler: packets with no protocol handler
• TX Errors (total): sum of all TX error types

  |> map(fn: (r) => ({ r with series: r.instance + "  ·  " + (if r._field == "rx_errors" then "RX Errors (total)" else if r._field == "rx_crc_errors" then "CRC" else if r._field == "rx_length_errors" then "Length" else if r._field == "rx_missed_errors" then "Missed" else if r._field == "rx_over_errors" then "Overrun" else if r._field == "rx_fifo_errors" then "RX FIFO" else if r._field == "rx_frame_errors" then "Frame" else if r._field == "rx_dropped" then "RX Dropped" else if r._field == "rx_nohandler" then "RX No Handler" else if r._field == "tx_errors" then "TX Errors (total)" else if r._field == "tx_dropped" then "TX Dropped" else if r._field == "tx_carrier_errors" then "Carrier" else if r._field == "tx_aborted_errors" then "Aborted" else if r._field == "tx_fifo_errors" then "TX FIFO" else if r._field == "tx_heartbeat_errors" then "Heartbeat" else if r._field == "tx_window_errors" then "Window" else if r._field == "collisions" then "Collisions" else r._field) }))
  |> group(columns: ["series"], mode: "by")
  |> keep(columns: ["_time", "_value", "series"])
  |> yield(name: "delta")

panels.title: NIC TX Errors & Drops (Per Interval)

panels.description:
Driver/hardware counters from "ethtool -S" that are non-zero, accumulated since boot (the "ethtool_" prefix is removed).
Alert levels: 🟩 0 = OK · 🟨 1–99 = attention · 🟧 100–999 = warning · 🟥 1,000–9,999 = critical · dark red ≥10,000 = severe.
Note: not every counter is an error. Example: rx_steer_missed_packets (mlx5) = packets that did not match any flow-steering rule — often normal background traffic; only investigate if it keeps growing quickly. Check the chart on the right to see whether a counter is still increasing.
